key_insight: PRISM automates multi-phase renal CT into registered subtraction maps, making enhancement differences easier to see with a reproducible, open-source pipeline.
clinical_relevance: It could reduce manual effort and subjectivity in RCC CT interpretation while supporting higher-resolution visualization of phase-specific enhancement.
method: DICOM phase classification, isotropic interpolation, and kidney segmentation
Three-step registration: rigid, affine, then B-spline with SimpleITK
Dual-channel subtraction visualization with color-coded enhancement mapping
evidence_signal: The authors ran 200 registrations across five patients and five experiments, finding a 40 mm B-spline grid, 5% metric sampling, and a single-level pyramid gave near-optimal quality with lower compute cost.
watch_item: Performance was tested on a small dataset, so broader validation is needed before routine clinical deployment.
paper_title: PRISM: Phase-Resolved Isotropic Subtraction Mapping for Automated Multi-Phase CT Digital Subtraction Angiography
